toc: false
page-layout: full
listing:
  id: statute-list
  contents: statutes
  type: table
  fields: [title, year, domain, status, cite]
  field-display-names:
    title: Statute
    year: Year
    domain: Domain
    status: Status
    cite: Citation
  sort: "year"
  sort-ui: [title, year, domain, status]
  filter-ui: true
  categories: true

---

```{r}
source("R/helpers.R")
statutes <- load_statutes()
edges    <- load_edges()
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
# one chip per domain, linking to the filtered list below
counts <- statutes |>
  dplyr::count(domain, domain_label) |>
  dplyr::arrange(match(domain, names(domain_labels)))

chips <- paste0(
  "<button type=\"button\" class=\"domain-chip domain-", counts$domain,
  "\" data-category=\"", counts$domain_label, "\">",
  "<span class=\"chip-count\">", counts$n, "</span> ", counts$domain_label, "</button>"
)

cat("<div class=\"domain-chips\">", chips, "</div>", sep = "\n")
cat(
  "\n", nrow(statutes), " statutes and ", nrow(edges), " recorded connections. ",
  "Open the [knowledge graph](graph.qmd) to see how they fit together, or the ",
  "[manifest](manifest.qmd) for every citation and source link.\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

## All statutes

Type in the filter box to search titles and citations, click a column to sort, or pick a category on the right to narrow by domain, status, or U.S. Code title. The search icon in the top bar searches the full text of every page.

::: {#statute-list}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
// a domain chip clicks the matching entry in the Categories list
document.querySelectorAll(".domain-chip").forEach(function (chip) {
  chip.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var wanted = chip.dataset.category;
    document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing-category .category").forEach(function (el) {
      if (el.textContent.trim().indexOf(wanted) === 0) { el.click(); }
    });
    document.getElementById("all-statutes").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  });
});
</script>
```
